tools.name: tour_search
tools.description: Search the public pages of Victoria Tour & Adventure (tours, destinations, day trips). Returns up to 10 matches, each with title, a short excerpt and the page URL. Call tour_page with a URL to read the full page.

tools.name: tour_page
tools.description: Read one public page of the Victoria Tour & Adventure app by URL (or a path such as /tours/whale-watching). Returns the page title and cleaned main text, up to about 6,000 characters, plus the URL. Only pages on the tour app's own domain are read.

tools.name: store_search
tools.description: Search the live Amiri store catalog. market is "US" (amazon.com) or "CA" (amazon.ca). Returns up to 20 matches with product name, department, an Amazon link carrying the affiliate tag for that market, the ASIN used, and an image URL. Prices are never included: check Amazon for the current price.

tools.name: store_departments
tools.description: List the Amiri store's departments (categories) with the number of products in each, largest first.

tools.name: ielts_search
tools.description: Search the public pages of Cyrus IELTS (visa and study guidance). Returns up to 10 matches, each with title, a short excerpt and the page URL.

tools.name: ielts_contact
tools.description: Return Cyrus IELTS contact details: email, WhatsApp and website.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tour_search, tour_page, store_search, ielts_search · Private data: ielts_contact · Public sink: ielts_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tour_search, tour_page, store_search, ielts_search · Private data: ielts_contact · Public sink: ielts_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
